cost is still $20,000, which is almost double the price from last year,
since we are removing Encord Active from our subscription. As previously
discussed, we found no value in this feature after extensive conversations
with your team, and we expected the price of Encord Annotate to remain
relatively the same as last year.

*From last year:*
Encord Annotate (5 complimentary users): $9,000
Encord 5 User Bundle:  $2,500
Encord Active: $10,000
Total Annual Fee(s) Due: $21,500

Could you please clarify what accounts for the additional $8,500, which is
approximately a 74% price increase from last year for Encord Annotate?
Given our efforts in recommending Encord to new users and providing regular
feedback, it is disappointing to see no significant new features that have
benefited us over the past year. Additionally, customer service has
significantly decreased in the past few months which is worrying me.

Best,

subject: Re: Labeling project
text:
Hi Santiago,

I hope you are well!

The past few days I reviewed several annotations (100~200 videos) and I
wrote my comments and suggestions while I decided to reject them. In
general, some labelers did very well, not only the frames range of
activities, but also describe the activities as we expected. There are also
some videos that were not annotated correctly, in particular the
descriptions are very general, like "A person lifts an object" or "A person
lowers an object". These descriptions won't give us any information beyond
the labels. For these annotations, I rejected them from my end, but please
have the team read the doc carefully. There are also some videos in which
the frame range of activity was not labeled correctly. I rejected them and
gave my suggestion in the comments. Thanks!

One more question about the platform, how can I easily filter out what I
have reviewed so that I can read my comments. Otherwise I have to reopen
another sheet to record my comments.

This week, I will spare my time to continue reviewing the videos and I
believe your team could annotate the rest videos very well when they get
the feedback.

Best regards,

Jun

subject: Re: UPDATE: Slice Sync in Encord
text:
Hi Emil,

Many thanks for this update.

The timeline looks very promising to Optellum (i.e. in time for our main study), but given that our earlier communication
about this feature was  misaligned with its first released functionality, we would be grateful if  Encord could update Optellum
about how the next iteration of this feature will work please?

Note there are 2 x use-cases we would expect to use in our main trial:
- geometrical syncing (match axial plane browsing by the z-coordinated indicated on the DICOM headers),
 between axial planes of the same CT-scan displayed on different tiles; and
- geometrical syncing between 2 different DICOM series - either CT-scans or secondary captures -
displayed on different tiles via the custom-layout configuration.

In the context of our main study, these would allow trial participants to correctly review e.g. both the MIP and
the AI-aided secondary capture (alongside the original CT-scan), respectively, when annotating the CT-scan
for suspicious lung nodules.

Please do let us know also in case one of them would not be present in the next release.
The latter (making use of the custom-layout) would be the priority for us.

Many Thanks,
Best Wishes,
